note.ja: 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
note.en: Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.
